title: Executive Order No. 84, s. 2025
text:
MALACANAN PALACE
MANILA

BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES

EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 84

INCREASING THE SUBSISTENCE ALLOWANCE OF MILITARY
PERSONNEL OF THE ARMED FORCES OF THE PHILIPPINES

WHEREAS, under Section 3, Article Il of the Constitution, the Armed Forces
of the Philippines (AFP) is the protector of the people and the State;

WHEREAS, Section 5(3), Article XVI of the Constitution declares that
professionalism in the armed forces and adequate remuneration and benefit of its
members shall be a prime concern of the State;

WHEREAS, Congress Joint Resolution No. 4 (s. 2009), in relation to Letter of
Implementation No. 99 (s. 1979), authorized the President to approve adjustments in
the allowances of all government personnel, including Subsistence Allowance of the
AFP, upon the recommendation of the Department of National Defense (DND) and
Department of Budget and Management (DBM);

WHEREAS, the Subsistence Allowance of all Officers and Enlisted Personnel
of the AFP was last adjusted in 2015 pursuant to Congress Joint Resolution No. 5
(s. 2015);

WHEREAS, it has been observed that the current Subsistence Allowance of
AFP Personnel is no longer adequate to meet the daily sustenance of an active-duty
soldier, which is essential for their well-being and performance of their duties;

WHEREAS, the DND and DBM recommend to increase the Subsistence
Allowance of all Officers and Enlisted Personnel of the AFP; and

WHEREAS, it is imperative to increase the Subsistence Allowance of all
Officers and Enlisted Personnel of the AFP, to protect and promote their welfare, in
recognition of their sacrifices and perseverance, in defending and upholding the
country’s sovereignty and territorial integrity;

NOW, THEREFORE, |, FERDINAND R. MARCOS, JR., President of the

Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by the Constitution and existing laws,
do hereby order:

THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
 
Section 1. Subsistence Allowance. The Subsistence Allowance for Officers
and Enlisted Personnel of the AFP, including trainees and Probationary Second
Lieutenants/Ensigns undergoing military training, Citizen Military Training cadets on
summer camp training and reserve officers and enlisted reservists undergoing training
and assembly/mobilization test, Citizen Armed Force Geographical Unit, and cadets,
is hereby increased from One Hundred Fifty Pesos (P 150.00) to Three Hundred Fifty
Pesos (P350.00) per day, effective 01 January 2025.

Section 2. Funding. The amounts necessary to carry out the implementation
of this Order shall be charged against available appropriations of the AFP under
Republic Act No. 12116 or the “General Appropriations Act for Fiscal Year 2025,” and
such other funding sources that the DBM may identify, subject to relevant budgeting,
accounting, and auditing laws, rules and regulations. Thereafter, the funding
requirements necessary for the continued implementation of this Order shall be
included in the budget proposals of the AFP, subject to the usual budget preparation
process.

Section 3. Separability. If any section or part of this Order is declared
unconstitutional or invalid, the other sections or provisions not otherwise affected shall
remain in full force and effect.

Section 4. Repeal. All orders, rules and regulations, and other issuances or
parts thereof, which are inconsistent with this Order, are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly.

Section 5. Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately upon
publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.

DONE, in the City of Manila, this 14th day of March , in the
year of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty-Five.

By the President:

   
 

UGAS P. BERSAMIN —
Ekecutive Secrptary
